name: Girlfriend Guide
source:
Scott's father is threatening to withhold his 'fun-money' if he doesn't get his life together and find a long-term girlfriend. Scott, whose university life was all about partying and chasing random girls, doesn't have a clue what to do now. Will he find his true love or fail miserably?

[from [url=https://painappuruproject.itch.io/girlfriend-guide]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
斯科特的父亲威胁说，如果他不重新开始生活并找到一个长期的女朋友，他将扣留他的“娱乐费”。斯科特的大学生活就是参加派对和随机追逐女孩，但他现在不知道该怎么办。他会找到真爱还是惨遭失败？

[来自[url=https://painappuruproject.itch.io/girlfriend-guide]itch.io[/url]]
